# Analysis
Both tempograms show strong rhythmic periodicities around 120–130 BPM, which is a common characteristic of dance-oriented music.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

plot_tempogram <- function(file, label) {

  read_csv(file) |>
    pivot_longer(-TIME, names_to = "tempo", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(tempo = as.numeric(tempo)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = TIME, y = tempo, fill = value)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Tempogram:", label),
      x = "Time (s)",
      y = "Tempo (BPM)"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(40, 300)) +
    theme_minimal()

}

plot_tempogram("twohearts-tempogram.csv", "Two of Hearts")
plot_tempogram("levo-tempogram.csv", "Levo")
```
